The Chemistry team develops AI-based methods to accelerate novel materials discovery for climate and AR/VR applications. The material domains currently being worked on are electro-catalysts for CO2RR & OER, nano-porous materials for direct air capture, and new materials for display technologies.
cond_0231.responsibilities:
Lead research to advance the science and technology of intelligent machines.
Lead research that enables advances in AI applied to chemistry and material science.
Devise better data-driven models of chemistry and materials.
Work towards long-term ambitious research goals, while identifying intermediate milestones.
Share findings and influence progress of relevant research communities by producing publications and actively engaging with peers.
Contribute research that can be applied to [Company name masked] product development.
Lead and collaborate closely with colleagues on research projects within a globally based team, staying in regular contact across groups to align on direction and resolve questions.
cond_0231.requirements:
Currently has or is in the process of obtaining a PhD in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Artificial Intelligence, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining [Company name masked].
Experience applying artificial intelligence to a scientific domain such as computational photonics, computational design, computational chemistry, etc.
Experience devising data-driven models and real-system experiments and design implementation for AI design and optimization.
Experience with scalable machine learning systems, resource-efficient AI data and algorithm scaling, or neural network architectures.
Experience with Python, C++, C, Julia, or other related language.
Experience communicating complex research clearly to peers and public audiences, including explaining trade-offs and walking others through findings.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as Pytorch, Jax, or Tensorflow.
Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR, or similar.
Must obtain work authorization in country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ Years of work experience in an industry, university, or government lab.
Demonstrated research and software engineering experience via an internship, work experience, coding competitions, or widely used contributions in open source repositories (e.g. GitHub).
Experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches.
Experience manipulating and analyzing complex, large scale, high-dimensionality data from varying sources.
Experience in utilizing theoretical and empirical research to solve problems.
Experience doing optimization based on machine learning and/or deep learning methods.
Experience solving complex problems and comparing alternative solutions, tradeoffs, and diverse points of view to determine a path forward.
Experience working and communicating cross functionally in a team environment, including initiating discussions to clarify requirements and keep projects on track.

People in this role are expected to be recognized experts in areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, AI applied to chemistry or material science, computational statistics, and applied mathematics, including deep learning, graphical models, reinforcement learning, computer perception, natural language processing, and data representation. The Chemistry team develops AI-based methods to accelerate novel materials discovery for climate and AR/VR applications. The material domains currently being worked on are electro-catalysts for CO2RR & OER, nano-porous materials for direct air capture, and new materials for display technologies. A regular part of this role is staying in contact with collaborators and communicating findings across a globally based team.
cond_0240.responsibilities:
Lead research to advance the science and technology of intelligent machines.
Lead research that enables advances in AI applied to chemistry and material science.
Devise better data-driven models of chemistry and materials.
Work towards long-term ambitious research goals, while identifying intermediate milestones.
Influence progress of relevant research communities by producing publications and actively contributing to discussions in those communities.
Contribute research that can be applied to [Company name masked] product development.
Lead and regularly collaborate on research projects within a globally based team, communicating progress and findings clearly to teammates across locations.
cond_0240.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Artificial Intelligence, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining [Company name masked].
Experience applying artificial intelligence to a scientific domain such as computational photonics, computational design, computational chemistry, etc.
Experience devising data-driven models and real-system experiments and design implementation for AI design and optimization.
Experience with scalable machine learning systems, resource-efficient AI data and algorithm scaling, or neural network architectures.
Experience with Python, C++, C, Julia, or other related language.
Experience communicating complex research for public audiences of peers.
Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR, or similar.
Must obtain work authorization in country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment.
2+ Years of work experience in an industry, university, or government lab.
Experience working and communicating cross functionally in a team environment.
Preferred Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as Pytorch, Jax, or Tensorflow.
Demonstrated research and software engineering experience via an internship, work experience, coding competitions, or widely used contributions in open source repositories (e.g. GitHub).
Experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches.
Experience manipulating and analyzing complex, large scale, high-dimensionality data from varying sources.
Experience in utilizing theoretical and empirical research to solve problems.
Experience doing optimization based on machine learning and/or deep learning methods.
Experience solving complex problems and comparing alternative solutions, tradeoffs, and diverse points of view to determine a path forward.

cond_0396.intro: [Company name masked] is looking for a Research Scientist to join Fundamental AI Research (FAIR), a research organization focused on making significant progress in AI, on the Chemistry team. Individuals in this role are expected to be recognized experts in identified research areas such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, AI applied to chemistry or material science, computational statistics, and applied mathematics, particularly including areas such as deep learning, graphical models, reinforcement learning, computer perception, natural language processing and data representation.
